estimates.assumptions: 175 g digestive biscuits (standard UK digestive ~66 g carbs/100 g, 2.5 g fiber/100 g)
200 g Bramley apples, peeled and sliced (raw edible portion ~11 g carbs/100 g, 2 g fiber/100 g)
75 g caster sugar (100 g carbs/100 g, no fiber)
2 large free-range eggs, beaten (~0.4 g carbs per egg, negligible fiber; assumes standard large eggs ~50 g each without shell)
75 g ground almonds (~10 g carbs/100 g, 6 g fiber/100 g)
1 tsp almond extract (~5 g; ~20 g carbs/100 g, negligible fiber; contribution small but not zero)
50 g flaked almonds (~11 g carbs/100 g, 7 g fiber/100 g)
